description: This file is a configuration setup for ESLint tailored for a Vue.js project using TypeScript. It imports various plugins and configurations, then exports a default configuration object that specifies which files to lint and ignore, as well as applying multiple plugin-based configurations.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: A function that defines and returns an ESLint configuration object, merging project-specific rules with Vue and TypeScript configurations.
